entries.name: tibo-base
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve.
Asset type: actual transparent 8-direction character sprite sheet for an isometric action/army-command game. Input image 1 is the identity reference: the public profile avatar of Thibault ("Tibo") Sottiaux. It is a likeness reference, not an edit target. This is clearly fictional, comedic game character art, not a claim about the real person's behavior.
Primary request: translate the photographed man into a beautifully cohesive, readable hand-painted game character. Preserve recognizable short dark swept hair, face shape, fair skin and friendly smile, wear a black hoodie, charcoal trousers and worn light sneakers. Small mint-glowing handheld command terminal. Ordinary contemporary tech-worker appearance, a slightly mischievous expression, NOT generic armored cyberpunk or fantasy wizard.
Style/medium: clean illustrated tactical-game miniature, deliberately chunky readable forms, crisp soft-shaded edges, very little fine texture, muted slate and warm concrete palette with a small mint accent, consistent warm upper-left lighting. Orthographic isometric camera viewing downward about 35 degrees. Entire body visible in every pose. At game size the face, black hoodie and pale sneakers read clearly.
Composition: transparent landscape sheet, exactly 8 equal columns by 4 equal rows, invisible regular grid, ideally 2048x1024. Precisely 32 separate poses of ONE SAME character, each centered in its equal cell, generous completely transparent gutters, same scale and ground baseline at 87 percent of its cell, no overlapping cells, no contact-shadow blobs.
Columns left-to-right are facing SCREEN south/down, southeast/down-right, east/right, northeast/up-right, north/up/back, northwest/up-left, west/left, southwest/down-left. These are genuine different angle drawings: back-facing poses must show the back of his head and hoodie, not his face or a rotated flat frontal portrait.
Row 1: idle pose, feet grounded, relaxed terminal in one hand.
Row 2: walking stride A, left foot forward, slight arm counter-swing, terminal retained.
Row 3: walking stride B, right foot forward, opposite arm counter-swing, terminal retained.
Row 4: command/cast gesture, extending one arm with a tiny mint screen glint, no huge effects or scale change.
Constraints: background really transparent with alpha, no white or checkerboard backdrop, no grid lines, no labels, no text, no logos, no watermark, no other characters, no environment. Identical identity/clothes/proportions across all 32 views. Do not crop any head, hand or foot. Original stylized drawing informed by the avatar.

entries.name: codex-crew
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: actual transparent animated robot sprite atlas for an isometric game.
Input image 1 is the user's CODEx mascot reference. Its COLOR IDENTITY is the most important invariant: saturated cyan-blue chassis with lighter sky-blue highlights and deeper azure side panels, very dark almost-black faceplate and outlines/joints, vivid acid-lime green simple friendly face on the screen, warm saturated yellow as secondary utility trim. The robot's rounded rectangular monitor head, ear-like side blocks, little antenna, compact humanoid torso and chunky feet are the base design language. The yellow display plinth and off-white background are NOT part of the sprites.
Primary request: four specialized Codex helper robots derived from this exact blue/black/lime/yellow visual identity, 8 genuine animation poses each. Match the reference colors strongly, do NOT desaturate it into ivory-gray robots or mint faces. Adapt its chunky clear silhouette into clean hand-painted miniature game art with crisp dark contour, very simple flat shaded panels and minimal texture, viewed down 35 degrees in orthographic isometric 3/4, all facing lower-right. Friendly coding assistants becoming a tiny industrial army.
Row 1 Scout: most faithful to reference, compact blue humanoid monitor-head helper, black screen with lime eyes/smile, antenna and chunky blue feet.
Row 2 Runner: blue slim speedy robot with longer articulated legs and small swept antenna, black face screen and lime smile, small yellow ankle stripe.
Row 3 Bulwark: broader blue guardian with heavy rectangular shoulders and chunky feet, black face screen and lime eyes, thick dark joints, a compact yellow/blue shield on one arm.
Row 4 Courier: short blue delivery robot with the same monitor head and lime face, small yellow cargo basket and tiny wheels under chunky feet, parcel-carrying grabber hands.
Columns left to right for EVERY row: idle; walk stride 1; walk stride 2; walk stride 3; walk stride 4; work/attack windup; work/attack contact; work/attack recovery. Scout taps a console, Runner quick strike, Bulwark shield shove, Courier lifts a parcel. Limbs really change across the frames. Consistent identity, clothes/panels and body scale throughout a row.
Layout: exactly 8 columns and 4 rows, precise equal invisible grid, landscape 2:1 ideally 2048x1024, 32 sprites total. All complete extremities within each cell, generous transparent gutters, identical ground baseline at 86 percent of each cell. No stand/plinth, ground disk or cast shadows. Silhouettes must read at 40-60 pixels.
Constraints: genuine alpha transparency, no backdrop or checkerboard, no labels/grid, no extra lettering or watermark. Preserve the reference's saturated cyan-blue, black screen, acid-lime face and yellow accent relationship. No extra human character. The result is a usable sprite sheet, not a presentation board.

entries.name: specialists-base
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent animation sprite atlas for an isometric pre-cyberpunk dystopian army-command game.
Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its chunky clean hand-painted game miniatures, readable proportions, soft upper-left light, orthographic camera looking down 35 degrees. These are original fictional satirical game designs. Do not reproduce the reference character.
Primary request: exactly four character rows with eight actual animation frames each.
Row 1 Borer: industrial digging helper bot, broad ivory steel barrel body on squat black treads, two heavy shovel claws, mint status screen, understated worn amber safety paint.
Row 2 Forge: mobile furnace robot, slate barrel chassis on thick legs, warm orange contained furnace door, ivory heat shield, mint little face display and practical chimney; never giant flames outside the cell.
Row 3 Caution Systems officer: original fictional ordinary office/security person, messy curly brown hair, rectangular glasses, peach cardigan under a beige utility vest, slate trousers and simple sneakers, holding a clipboard/tool; human proportions exaggerated to match the reference's game miniatures. Distinct fictional corporate caricature, not a portrait of any real CEO.
Row 4 Velocity Dynamics marshal: original fictional hefty corporate security commander, short silver hair, angular charcoal jacket over a dark shirt, chunky industrial shoulder armor, subtle scarlet trim, heavy boots and a compact baton. Distinct fictional design, not any real CEO's likeness or logo.
For every row, columns left to right: idle, walk 1, walk 2, walk 3, walk 4, action windup, action contact, action recovery. Real different limb/tool positions, same identity and equipment throughout the row. Borer digs, Forge runs a contained heat pulse, officer gestures with clipboard, marshal swings the baton. All face screen lower-right throughout. Non-graphic cartoon action, no injured people, gore or violence scene.
Composition: exactly 8 equal columns x 4 equal rows, landscape 2:1 atlas, ideally 2048x1024, 32 sprites. Identical cell-centered scale and ground baseline at 86 percent. Every head, hand, claw, tool and effect wholly inside its cell with wide transparent gutters. Readable tiny-game silhouettes, no excessive texture.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background/alpha, no ground/shadows, no checkerboard, no labels or grid, no text, logos or watermark. Original machines and fictional rival employees. Do not crop or overlap any sprite.

entries.name: specialists-color
entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer.
Input image 1 is the edit target: four-row animation atlas. Input image 2 is color reference ONLY: the approved bright-blue Codex crew.
Change ONLY the COLORS of the ROBOTS in the top TWO rows of image 1. Keep their shapes, chunky mechanical details, silhouette, poses, animation order, tools, tread/feet, all 8x4 cell positions, gutters and transparent background unchanged. Change their ivory/beige and gray main outer armor to the same rich saturated cyan-blue and azure panels as image 2. Face screens remain almost black but eye pixels/status faces become vivid acid-lime green. Keep dark rubber/mechanical joints black/charcoal. Safety accents become clean warm saturated yellow. The Forge furnace remains orange/fire-colored and the Borer shovels can retain dark metal. Do NOT change their identities or equipment.
CRITICAL: preserve the bottom two rows of human corporate opponents exactly: peach-cardigan curly-haired clipboard officer in row 3 and charcoal/scarlet-armored silver-haired marshal in row 4. Do NOT recolor these humans blue or replace them with robots.
Keep exact original 8-column 4-row sprite layout and image proportions, all sprites entirely inside their original cells. Preserve true alpha transparency. No background, grid, labels, text or watermark. This is a targeted robot-faction palette correction, not a redesign.

entries.name: structures-base
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent environment/structure sprite atlas for an isometric pre-cyberpunk dystopian game.
Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match the reference's clean chunky hand-painted miniatures, readable shapes, upper-left warm diffuse lighting, orthographic 35-degree-down isometric view. Do not draw humans.
Primary request: an actual 4x4 sprite atlas of 16 contemporary structures, not a concept-art scene. Near-future Europe-ish town/industrial outskirts just BEFORE dystopia, concrete, brick, ordinary plastic panels, warm amber windows, quiet mint terminal glows. Grounded and slightly cozy everyday life becoming industrial; no neon megacity, fantasy, holograms, real brands or logos.
STRICT row-major cells:
Row 1: 1 small black-hoodie tech operator's garage/workshop, brick walls, flat zinc roof, warm window and a tiny server rack visible in open doorway; 2 squat ivory/slate pulse security sentry turret with mint light; 3 short concrete Jersey road barrier with worn yellow stripes; 4 compact municipal utility/server tapping machine, gray housing and cable reels, mint terminal and orange caution panel.
Row 2: 5 a rival peach/beige corporate field office container with clean window and small folded awning; 6 chunky stationary orbital-uplink dish launcher in charcoal/ivory, mint screen, amber utility braces; 7 short modular concrete-and-metal footbridge segment with simple rail; 8 small exposed blue-gray municipal compute cabinet with mint LED lights, a renewable resource point.
Row 3: 9 stack of gray shipping crates and worn traffic cones; 10 intact ordinary white delivery van; 11 ordinary small café kiosk with striped warm canvas awning and glowing window, no lettering; 12 modest bus shelter with clear panels and bench, no ads/text.
Row 4: 13 sidewalk planter with low shrubs; 14 small streetlamp with warm light fixture, no large halo; 15 simple public park bench; 16 little gray utility meter box and pipes.
Composition: exactly four equal columns by four equal rows, square ideally 2048x2048, exactly one entire object centered per cell, consistent lower-right 3/4 view and ground baseline at 86 percent. Wide completely transparent gutters, no neighboring objects touching. No ground diamonds, roads or base plates except the bridge's own deck. Object sizes must fit entirely in each cell. Beautiful cohesive actual game assets with strong silhouettes.
Constraints: true alpha transparency, no backdrop, checkerboard, grid lines, captions, text, logos or watermark. No characters. No copied corporate iconography.

entries.name: structures-color
entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the edit target: a 4x4 contemporary structure sprite atlas. Input image 2 is the approved bright blue / black / lime / yellow Codex robot palette.
Keep the entire 4x4 atlas, all original objects, camera angle, cell positions, scales, silhouettes, alpha edges and transparent gutters unchanged. Change only the PLAYER MACHINERY colors:
Row 1 column 2 security sentry: outer armor becomes saturated cyan-blue/azure like the reference; joints and barrels stay dark charcoal; its black face screen has vivid acid-lime lights; yellow safety accents.
Row 1 column 4 server tap: main equipment casing blue/azure; dark internals; lime-on-black command display; strong yellow cable trim/caution panel.
Row 2 column 2 uplink dish launcher: blue/azure rim and equipment casing; dark charcoal mechanics; yellow support braces; lime-on-black command screen. Preserve the large pale dish interior.
Row 2 column 4 resource cabinet: keep ordinary gray metal body, but change mint LEDs to acid-lime.
Do NOT turn the everyday world blue. Preserve the brick garage, peach rival office, concrete barrier, bridge, crates, white van, warm café, bus shelter, plants, lamp, bench and meter exactly as they are. Keep warm windows amber. No added logos/text, no redesign, no backgrounds/shadow disks. Maintain genuine transparent alpha.

entries.name: districts
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent scenic prop atlas for an isometric pre-cyberpunk town/outskirts game.
Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match clean chunky hand-painted miniatures, crisp readable soft-shaded forms, warm diffuse upper-left light and consistent orthographic camera down 35 degrees. No reference person.
Primary request: exactly 16 separate everyday park/suburban/industrial-edge props in a precise 4x4 square atlas. This is an ordinary world just before cyberpunk arrives: weathered concrete, warm brick, green public parks, restrained warm gray and muted foliage. All original assets, cozy quiet life not post-apocalyptic ruins or neon futurism.
STRICT row-major cells:
Row 1: 1 rounded broadleaf municipal park tree; 2 warm amber-leaf street maple; 3 slim dark roadside pine; 4 dusty ornamental palm with sturdy trunk.
Row 2: 5 stack of rugged utility crates; 6 gray broken natural boulders; 7 small white delivery van, no branding; 8 plain contemporary bus shelter with bench, no writing.
Row 3: 9 clump of natural waterside reeds; 10 simple small wooden park bench; 11 slim ordinary warm streetlamp; 12 low gray utility meter cabinet.
Row 4: 13 trimmed park shrub; 14 paired small gray trash/recycling bins; 15 a square low flowering sidewalk planter; 16 pair of concrete sidewalk bollards.
Composition: exact equal 4-column x 4-row grid, square ideally 2048x2048, one isolated entire prop centered in each cell, shared ground baseline at 86 percent, generous completely transparent gutters, no overlap. No ground tiles, no background scenery or large shadows. Trees include trunks and are clearly separate tree sprites. Use enough detail to be attractive while retaining clear silhouettes at small game size.
Constraints: genuine transparent alpha background, no white, checkerboard, grid lines, labels, text, signs, logos or watermark. No people, no fantasy vegetation, no huge lighting halo around lamp.

entries.name: tibo-terminal-color
entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve.
Input image 1 is the edit target: a 32-pose 8-direction character sprite sheet of a smiling dark-haired man in a black hoodie. Input image 2 is the approved Codex blue/black/lime/yellow palette.
Make ONE small targeted color edit throughout image 1: change each handheld command terminal's body to saturated cyan-blue/azure and its mint/teal screen marks to vivid acid-lime on black, matching the palette of image 2. No other change.
Preserve the face identity, hair, black hoodie, trousers, pale shoes, all 32 exact poses, all eight front/side/back viewpoints, every pixel position/cell, scale, lighting and alpha silhouette. Do not redesign him or change expression. Keep the exact 8-column 4-row landscape layout and wide transparent gutters. Background stays genuinely transparent. No logos, extra characters, lettering or watermark.
